violated_contract: An authenticated server surface must default to denying cross-origin browser access. A wildcard (`*`) or blank/whitespace origin folded into the CORS allowlist — whether from a permissive default, a comma-split artifact, or an env value read before configuration loads — widens what any webpage may read off a Bearer-token-authenticated backend and must fail closed to an explicit empty allowlist instead.
canonical_prevention: Build every authenticated surface's CORS policy from one default-deny helper that loads the backend environment before parsing, comma-splits with strip, rejects `*` with a hard error, and returns an explicit allowlist with `allow_credentials=False`; cover both the module-level app and factory entrypoints with tests asserting blank/unset origins yield an empty allowlist and that a wildcard anywhere in the comma list raises.
